en: A monochrome postcard-style print showing a narrow street or courtyard dominated by a tall, slender minaret attached to a former church building. Leafless trees and old masonry surround the mosque complex. Below the photograph, printed captions in Italian, English, French, and (likely) German identify the subject as "The minaret of the church of Saint George / Il minareto della chiesa di San Giorgio / Le minaret de l'église de Saint Georges."
